# Fixtures for `dbf` (dBASE / FoxPro table)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour): made with GDAL and the Python dbf package. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/db.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `buoys.dbf` | ogr2ogr -f "ESRI Shapefile": a shapefile's attribute table | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-db3.dbf` | dbf (dbf_type db3): dBASE III with memo, one deleted record | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-fp.dbf` | dbf (dbf_type fp): FoxPro 2 with memo | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-vfp.dbf` | dbf (dbf_type vfp): Visual FoxPro | CC0-1.0 |
